meta.title: Recent sessions
meta.description: A Recent sessions row sits above Settings in the sidebar. Opening it floats a sheet over the workspace list with the latest sessions by last activity. A search field at the top takes focus when the sheet opens and filters by session title, workspace name or path, session ID and state; Escape clears it and drops focus. Clicking a row opens that session, collapses the sheet, and scrolls the sidebar to its workspace, expanding the group first when it is collapsed. Its settings sit behind a settings icon (the sliders glyph) in the title bar, collapsed by default so the list keeps its height: Subagents decides how subagent sessions are handled—folded into their main session (the main row ranks by the newest activity in its subtree and expands in place), hidden entirely, or one row each; Range limits the list to the last 1, 7 or 30 days, or no limit; Live bar keeps the bottom strip. All three save to the profile's plugin config, and the icon is tinted, with a dot, while a non-default filter is applied. The sheet spans the sidebar width and paints an opaque surface; archived sessions stay in the sidebar's archive. The entry row also carries the list's status dots: yellow when a listed session is waiting on you, green when a finished session has not been opened yet, both at once and without counts. The Live bar switch keeps a 28px strip at the bottom of the window that lists running, waiting and finished-unread sessions — the dot carries the state — and keeps a session that just stopped for 30 minutes, always visible without covering the columns. Click one to switch; right-click opens the session menu (pin, rename, fork, archive, copy session ID), and the count opens a floating list above the strip, which itself stays 28px. Pinned sessions stay on the strip until unpinned.
